The nightly update-pkgs run failed for continuum: `pkgs/continuum/ecdsa-keys.patch` no longer applies because upstream (commits a1e3986, bcda4d6, 45cdc3c, 2b9bb56, 2026-11-17) now contains all of it. After dropping it, the build failed in the check phase: upstream 2ac20de made the test `signs_through_an_ssh_agent` fail instead of skip without OpenSSH.

- drop `ecdsa-keys.patch` (fully upstream)
- `nativeCheckInputs = [ openssh ]` so the ssh-agent test runs (619 passed, 0 failed)
- `update.sh`: `nullglob` around the patch loop, so it works with no patches
- rev 393fb4d -> 10786d2, Cargo.lock regenerated by the update script

Written by the agentd agent update-fix-continuum, checked by Hermes (built on coaxmetal).

Not verified:
- not deployed / new binary not started (the agent checked that coaxmetal's continuum.json store-root is byte-identical to master's)
- `update.sh` still writes `1.0.0-unstable-<date>` although upstream now tags releases (v0.0.1)
